title: Synthesizing Past Modals in Bioethical Argumentation

sections.title: The Three Pillars of Ethical Evaluation
sections.content: When evaluating a complex medical or moral case at B2, combine three perspectives: (1) How sure were we? ('Valószínűleg tudta?' — Did he probably know?), (2) Potential prevention ('Mit lehetett volna megelőzni?' — What could have been prevented?), and (3) Deontic duty ('Mit kellett volna tennie?' — What should he/she have done?).

sections.title: A Story About Conscience
sections.content: The story in this lesson is an original story inspired by László Németh's novel Iszony (Németh was himself trained as a physician); it is not a scene from the book. It uses past modals to probe the boundary between external duty and inner conscience. Even when the doctor says 'ennél többet senki sem tehetett volna' (nobody could have done more), Nelli's conscience still asks what she should have done differently.

sections.title: Comprehensive Past Modal Matrix
rows: Biztosan / Valószínűleg / Talán / Kétlem, hogy (surely / probably / perhaps / I doubt that)
Megelőzhette volna / El lehetett volna kerülni (Could have prevented/avoided)
Intézkednie kellett volna (Should have taken action)
Nem szabadott volna halogatni (Should not have postponed)

items.spanish: Valószínűleg tudták a kockázatot, ezért a beteget korábban kórházba kellett volna szállítani.
items.english: They probably knew the risk, so the patient should have been taken to hospital earlier.

items.spanish: Ha időben felismerték volna a tüneteket, el lehetett volna kerülni a tragédiát.
items.english: Had they recognized the symptoms in time, the tragedy could have been avoided.

items.spanish: Az ápolónőnek nem volt miért vádolnia magát: ennél odaadóbban senki sem virraszthatott volna.
items.english: The nurse had no reason to blame herself: nobody could have kept vigil more devotedly than this.

sections.title: B2 Stylistic Notice
sections.content: Use concessive framing ('Bár valószínűleg nem tudták előre..., mégis óvatosabbnak kellett volna lenni') to construct balanced, high-scoring B2 argumentative essays.
